woodland-hills-church-st-paul-mn.assessment: RED/BLACK FLAG: Woodland Hills Church is led by Greg Boyd, a prominent progressive/Neo-Anabaptist theologian. Boyd holds to OPEN THEISM (God does not exhaustively know the future) — a position most evangelical denominations consider heretical. He advocates Christian pacifism and strongly opposes Christian political engagement. The church hosts 'Sacred Space,' an LGBT support group. Boyd has been called a 'progressive preacher' and his 2004 sermon series against political engagement caused 1,000 members to leave. While officially Converge-affiliated, Boyd's open theism, progressive social stances, and LGBT-welcoming posture place this church firmly outside conservative evangelical orthodoxy. NOT RECOMMENDED for doctrinally conservative men.

woodlands-methodist-gmc-tx.assessment: The Woodlands Methodist Church is the single largest church in the Global Methodist Church — 14,000 members who voted 96% to depart the UMC and join the GMC in 2023. That kind of institutional courage (leaving a denomination with all the attendant property and legal costs) signals a congregation serious about orthodox Wesleyan teaching. Rev. Mark Sorensen took over as Senior Pastor from the long-tenured Rev. Dr. Ed Robb in 2021, holds an M.Div from Asbury Theological Seminary, and has served the church since 2013. The church operates two campuses in the Houston suburbs, runs a preschool and a private elementary school, and offers 10 live and online worship services weekly. As with all GMC churches, the local stance on women as elders should be verified (the Texas conference varies), but the overall profile is solidly orthodox, Trinitarian, traditional-marriage Wesleyan.

world-changers-creflo-dollar.assessment: World Changers Church International is Creflo Dollar's prosperity gospel mega-church. Dollar teaches that financial wealth is a covenant right of believers, that giving to his ministry unlocks divine blessing, and that Jesus was wealthy. This is textbook prosperity gospel — a false gospel that exploits believers financially while distorting the biblical message of salvation. Dollar has faced multiple financial scandals and domestic abuse charges. Theologically disqualified. Not recommended.
